title: Andersonville Prison
source: All three native OSM fenceway1346210253 vertices bind the northeast reconstructed corner. Exact brown reconstruction paths extracted from federal NPS Harpers Ferry Center ANDEmap1.pdf (2018), whose own asset record explicitly states government-produced public domain, register the northgate wall and rectangular sallyport by affine transformation from those same three corner points. These are visitor-map controls, approximately3m per PDFpoint, not a measured building survey. Whole reconstruction midpoint anchor [-84.12865242639396,32.19546764916732],heading0, +X east/+Z south fixed before terrain/geometry. Mainwall about31m, corner arms about31m; sallyport approximately12x9m. Wallheight4.57m, door/wicket/sentry-platform dimensions, log census and deadline extent are photographic architectural estimates.

terrainContact.basis: Fixed northgate east threshold source point before independent field; provider-relative model datum, not a surveyed threshold.

notes: Present physical reconstructions of Andersonville Prison: both short stockade sections (northgate with rectangular two-gate sallyport and northeast L-corner), their roofed sentry platforms, diagonal-board gate leaves/wicket and short low deadline rail. No invented standing 1864 whole enclosure, barracks or prisoner tents. Separate museum/cemetery/monuments/Providence Spring shelter/Star Fort and general park landscape are excluded.
